title: 第3章 虎拳门第4章 一招击败
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: 本来清风城有六大宗门，分别为清风宗，虎拳门，黑熊门，铁剑宗，白沙门，擎天宗。
只是清风宗近年来没落，被从六大宗门中踢了出去，这才剩下五大宗门。不过与清风宗不同的是，这五大宗门发展一直稳定，每个宗门弟子都有上百，不像清风宗只有他师兄妹两人。
此时广场上人山人海，这倒是给了秦叶招收徒弟的机会，要是像平时那样，还不知道要等多少天才能招到了。
秦叶当时表示道：“不了，我们去租一个摊位。”
秦叶带着武萱儿很快就找到了租摊位的城主府执事，租了一个小摊位。
随着时间的流逝，来的人越来越多，其中大部分都是有家中长者带着年轻一辈来碰碰运气，其中虽然没有那种百年难得一见的天才，但是偶尔有天赋的，都会引得一片惊叹声。
就在刚才，铁剑宗就招到了一个12岁的少年，小小年纪就已经练体三重境界了。像这样的少年，要么有奇遇，要么就是家中有点势力。
一个时辰过去，秦叶的摊位几乎无人问津，偶尔有人过来问一声，也会迅速离开。清风宗是什么状况，只要是清风城本地的人相信都知道，自然不会让自己的子侄进入已经没落的清风宗。
看着其他宗门摊位面前排着长龙，再看看自己面前……
武萱儿有些着急地说道：“掌门师兄这样不行，我们去抢人吧。”
秦叶可是有系统在手的人，怎么可能去做这样损失风度的事情，打了一个哈欠道：“我清风宗注定是天下第一大宗，有缘者入，无缘者那是他们的损失，将来有他们后悔的时候。”
秦叶这话一说完，就走来五六个人，其中那个领头的中年男子嘲笑道：“好大的口气，还天下第一大宗，说这等大话也不怕闪了舌头。”
“你是谁？”秦叶瞥了一眼，问道。
“我乃虎拳门外门长老，听说那个老东西前几天死了，你清风宗只剩下你们两个人了，我见你们师兄妹还有点天赋，不如加入我虎拳门如何？”那中年男人神色傲然道。
虎拳门众人一行到来，自然吸引了不少人目光，毕竟现在虎拳门如日中天，实力早就取代了清风宗。这虎拳门来找清风宗的麻烦，自然少了一番吃瓜群众。
“清风宗掌门竟然死了，看来消息不假，前些日子在城外遇袭的便是这清风宗老掌门了。”
“这清风宗老掌门是在城主宴会返回途中遇袭的，会不会是城主府……”
“嘘！你不要命啦，连城主府都敢妄议。”
“听说清风宗剩下的弟子跑的跑，散的散，大部分都被虎拳门接受，这虎拳门现在来找清风宗的麻烦，这就有好戏看了。”
“哈哈……”秦叶突然大笑了起来。
“你笑什么？”中年男人不解地问道。
“我笑你白痴。”秦叶轻笑道。
“你……”中年男子神色怒不可遏。
“本座现在是清风宗的掌门，而到了你虎拳门最多不过一个内门弟子。我堂堂一个掌门不做，去做你一个内门弟子，我笑你白痴，难道不对吗？”
“一个撑不了几天的破落门派还敢在这里大放厥词，我虎拳门愿意收留你，那是看在你师兄妹还有点天赋的份上，哼，你竟然如此不识好歹。”
中年男子冷哼一声，脸色冷了下来。
说完，向着旁边一个虎拳门弟子示意了一个眼色。
那虎拳门弟子接收到外门长老的眼色，冷笑着走了出来，“秦叶不要给脸不要脸，长老看上你是给你机会，你不珍惜也不要耽误武师妹的前途。”
“张泽然你不要脸，背叛宗门，改投虎拳门，我武萱儿没有你这样的师兄。”武萱儿怒斥道。
原来这走出来的虎拳门弟子原是清风宗弟子，前几天改投了虎拳门，进入了虎拳门，做了虎拳门外门弟子。初来乍到，自然想要好好表现一番，如果能获得外门长老的好感，这对他以后有莫大的好处。
“卖主求荣，阿谀取容之徒，有何脸面在本掌门面前狗吠。”秦叶语气平淡地说道。
“秦叶我敬你曾经是大师兄，敬你三分，你既然不识好歹，那我也就不再客气了。”说着张泽然冷笑着向秦叶拍出一掌：“哼！你重伤还未痊愈，还敢在这里招收弟子，今天就教训你一下，让你知道什么才是现实。”
张泽然突然发难，自然是身旁中年男子授意，虎拳门与清风宗之前早就有冲突，而且虎拳门早就想吞并清风宗，只是没有一个绝佳的机会，现在机会摆到面前，自然不会错过。
对于张泽然突然动手，秦叶并没有露出害怕之色，而是嘴角泛起一丝笑意。真是想什么来什么，不错，他就是故意引他们出手。
凭清风宗现在这个状况想要招收一个普通弟子都是非常困难的，更不要说一个招收天才弟子了。正好，这些人送上门来，这给了秦叶出手的机会，只要展示出实力，自然能吸引到弟子加入。
秦叶也想苟，但是有的时候情势所迫，苟不起来。
张泽然掌风还未及身，秦叶同样拍出一掌，两掌相接，张泽然顿时啊的一声惨叫，飞了出去。
中年男子惊愕地看着秦叶，皱眉道：“你伤好了？”
张泽然练体四重巅峰的修为，离练体五重也只是半只脚的距离，如果不是伤好了，秦叶是不可能一掌将其击飞。
但是，据他所知，秦叶之前被伤的很重，不可能这么短的时间恢复过来。
“难道清风宗还有什么宝物？”中年男子心中寻思道。
“不管有没有宝物，先擒下他再说。”
中年男子冷哼一声，说道：“看来秦宗主刚刚坐上掌门之位，就已经不将我虎拳门放在眼里了。也好，就让本长老来会一会秦宗主。”
秦宗主两个字被他咬得极重，他自信以自己练体八重的修为能轻易拿下秦叶。
中年男子此话一出，顿时就引起一阵喧嚣。
content_en:
Originally, there were six major sects in Qingfeng City, namely Qingfeng Sect, Tiger Fist Sect, Black Bear Sect, Iron Sword Sect, Baisha Sect, and Qingtian Sect.
It's just that Qingfeng Sect has declined in recent years and been kicked out of the six major sects, leaving only five major sects. However, unlike the Qingfeng Sect, the development of these five major sects has been stable, and each sect has hundreds of disciples. Unlike the Qingfeng Sect, which only has his brother and sister.
At this time, the square was crowded with people, which gave Qin Ye the opportunity to recruit apprentices. If it was like usual, he didn't know how many days it would take to recruit one.
Qin Ye said at that time: "No, let's rent a stall."
Qin Ye and Wu Xuan'er quickly found the deacon of the City Lord's Mansion who rented a stall and rented a small stall.
As time goes by, more and more people come, and most of them are elders of the family bringing the younger generation to try their luck. Although there are no geniuses that are rare to see in a century, those who occasionally have talents will attract exclamations of exclamation.
Just now, Iron Sword Sect recruited a 12-year-old boy, who has already reached the third level of physical training at a young age. A boy like this either has an adventure or has some influence in his family.
An hour passed, and almost no one paid attention to Qin Ye's stall. Occasionally, if someone came over to ask, they would leave quickly. Anyone who is local in Qingfeng City knows what the situation of the Qingfeng Sect is. Naturally, they will not let their nephew enter the declining Qingfeng Sect.
Looking at the long queues in front of other sect stalls, and then looking in front of me...
Wu Xuan'er said anxiously: "Brother, this is not okay, let's go and rob people."
Qin Ye is a person with a system in hand. How could he do something that would lose his grace? He yawned and said: "Our Qingfeng Sect is destined to be the largest sect in the world. Those who are destined to join will join, and those who are not destined will be their loss. They will regret it in the future."
As soon as Qin Ye finished speaking, five or six people came over. The leading middle-aged man among them laughed and said: "You have such a big tone. You are the most powerful person in the world. You are not afraid of flashing your tongue when you say such big words."
"Who are you?" Qin Ye glanced at him and asked.
"I am the elder of the outer sect of the Tiger Fist Sect. I heard that the old guy died a few days ago. You two are the only ones left in your Qingfeng Sect. I see that you brothers and sisters still have some talent. How about joining my Tiger Fist Sect?" The middle-aged man said with an arrogant look.
The arrival of everyone from the Tiger Fist Sect naturally attracted a lot of attention. After all, the Tiger Fist Sect is now at its peak, and its strength has long replaced the Qingfeng Sect. Since the Tiger Fist Sect came to cause trouble for the Qingfeng Sect, it naturally lost a lot of people.
"The head of the Qingfeng Sect is actually dead. It seems the news is true. It was the old head of the Qingfeng Sect who was attacked outside the city a few days ago."
"The old head of the Qingfeng Sect was attacked on his way back from the City Lord's banquet. Could it be the City Lord's Mansion..."
"Shhh! You don't want your life, you dare to make such arrogant remarks even to the City Lord's Mansion."
"I heard that the remaining disciples of the Qingfeng Sect ran away and dispersed. Most of them were accepted by the Tiger Fist Sect. Now that the Tiger Fist Sect is looking for trouble with the Qingfeng Sect, there will be a good show."
"Haha..." Qin Ye suddenly laughed.
"Why are you laughing?" the middle-aged man asked in confusion.
"I laugh at you as an idiot." Qin Ye chuckled.
"You..." The middle-aged man looked furious.
"I am now the head of the Qingfeng Sect, and when I come to your Tiger Fist Sect, I can only have one inner disciple at most. If I don't become the head of the mighty Sect, and I become your inner disciple, I will laugh at you as an idiot, isn't that right?"
"A run-down sect that can't survive for a few days still dares to talk nonsense here. Our Tiger Fist Sect is willing to take you in because your senior brothers and sisters still have some talent. Humph, you are so ignorant."
The middle-aged man snorted and his face turned cold.
After saying that, he winked at the disciple of the Tiger Fist Sect next to him.
The disciple of the Tiger Fist Sect received the look from the elder of the outer sect and walked out with a sneer, "Qin Ye, don't be shameless. The elder is interested in you to give you a chance. If you don't cherish it, don't delay Junior Sister Wu's future."
"Zhang Zeran, you are shameless. You betrayed the sect and joined the Tiger Fist Sect. I, Wu Xuan'er, don't have a senior brother like you." Wu Xuan'er scolded angrily.
It turns out that the disciple of the Tiger Fist Sect who came out was originally a disciple of the Qingfeng Sect. He switched to the Tiger Fist Sect a few days ago, entered the Tiger Fist Sect, and became an outer disciple of the Tiger Fist Sect. When he first arrived, he naturally wanted to perform well. If he could win the favor of the elders from the outer sect, it would be of great benefit to him in the future.
"A seller seeking glory and a flatterer, how can he have the face to bark in front of this leader." Qin Ye said in a calm tone.
"Qin Ye, I respect you as a senior brother. I respect you three points. Since you don't know what is good, I will no longer be polite." Zhang Zeran sneered and slapped Qin Ye: "Huh! You haven't recovered from your serious injury yet, yet you dare to recruit disciples here. I will teach you a lesson today and let you know what reality is."
Zhang Zeran's sudden attack was naturally inspired by the middle-aged man next to him. The Tiger Fist Sect and the Qingfeng Sect had been in conflict for a long time, and the Tiger Fist Sect had long wanted to annex the Qingfeng Sect, but there was no perfect opportunity. Now that the opportunity was presented to him, he would not miss it.
Regarding Zhang Zeran's sudden attack, Qin Ye did not show fear, but a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth. It really comes to what he wants. Yes, he just deliberately led them to take action.
With the current situation of Qingfeng Sect, it is very difficult to recruit an ordinary disciple, let alone recruit a genius disciple. It just so happened that these people came to the door, which gave Qin Ye a chance to take action. As long as he showed his strength, he would naturally attract disciples to join him.
Qin Ye also wanted to live in peace, but sometimes he was forced by circumstances and couldn't live in peace.
Before the wind from Zhang Zeran's palm reached him, Qin Ye also slapped a palm, and the two palms connected. Zhang Zeran screamed and flew out.
The middle-aged man looked at Qin Ye in shock, frowned and said, "Are you healed?"
Zhang Zeran's cultivation at the fourth level of physical training was only half a foot away from the fifth level of physical training. If his injury hadn't healed, Qin Ye wouldn't have been able to knock him away with one palm.
However, as far as he knew, Qin Ye was seriously injured before and could not recover in such a short time.
"Does the Qingfeng Sect have any other treasures?" the middle-aged man thought in his mind.
"Whether there is any treasure or not, let's capture him first."
The middle-aged man snorted coldly and said: "It seems that Sect Master Qin has just taken the position of leader and no longer pays attention to our Tiger Fist Sect. It's okay, let me come and meet Sect Master Qin for a while."
The word "Qin Zongzhu" was spoken very seriously by him, and he was confident that he could easily defeat Qin Ye with his eighth level of physical training.
As soon as the middle-aged man said these words, there was an uproar immediately.
